description:
A markup `${ if … }` lift group re-renders the reactive reads inside its taken arm while that arm stays taken, and an if / else if / else chain selects every arm. Two groups: `${ if (@shown) { lift

${@n}

} }` (a read the condition does not mention) and a three-arm chain over `@mode` whose every arm reads `@n`. Clicks: #inc, #toB, #inc, #toC. Pre-fix (impl#1): the group's effect returned early while its FIRST condition's truthiness was unchanged, so #n stayed "0" and the chain never left its `else if` arm for the `else` arm (`@mode == "a"` was false both times). The presence-condition sibling is control-flow/markup-if-presence-arm-reads-rerender-pos.
rationale: §7.4.2: "When `expr` references one or more reactive cells (`@x` access), the interpolation site SHALL re-render whenever any referenced cell changes — the standard reactive subscription contract". §17.1: "`if=` is sugar over `${ if(expr) { lift <element>...</element> } }`." §10.8.2: "When `lift` appears in an `if`/`else` body, only the taken branch's `lift` calls SHALL be added to the accumulator." Gap: g-impl1-markup-if-branch-memo-stale-render-s462.
